plain_language_zh: 本合同定义五个主表臂、四组消融、一个附录臂和一个可选臂各自怎样填同一张代价表、怎样做同一个存在判定，以及每个方法的配置网格上限。输入是 S0-03 封存的特征行与各臂登记参数；输出是喂给 S0-03 求解器的 logit、逐实体的 RETRACT/NOOP 决定和编译后的原子程序。例如 TAF 对余弦 0.8 的合格候选给 logit 0.8、对不合格候选给哨兵值，ELU-P 对连续被自由空间覆盖的实体把 log-odds 压到门下记 RETRACT。它不训练、不选参、不读私有数据；所有数值待冻结为 null。合同里的每一个布尔值都被校验器绑定。

shared.plain_language_zh: 五个臂与四组消融共用冻结前端、S0-03 召回与求解器、S0-01 执行器、共享去重与 dormancy 规则、S0-04 评价器；差别只在 logit 怎么来、存在决定怎么做。存在判定候选是 active 或 dormant、且本帧应可见比例不低于登记下限的未分配实体；这个下限五臂共享，因为它决定谁会累计错失次数、谁会休眠。裁决 67（2026-09-24）冻结为 0.5：实体盒的 64 个采样格心过半落进本帧可见体积才算应可见。裁决 68（2026-09-25，LOG-256 续）取代为 1/64：S1-03 的可见体积是视锥内、深度表面之前的体素，而实体框是单帧深度表面壳，正对着看的在场物体也只有约一半采样格心在表面之前，0.5 只让 0.2% 的实体-帧成为存在候选（44,097 帧 2,068 个）；1/64 即任一格心在表面之前的视锥内就算应可见（3.5% 的实体-帧，约每帧 5 个候选）。几何规则本身的修订登记为候选（DECISIONS 待裁 68 (8)(b)），由开发表趟的规则臂读数决定是否提出。

cost_interface.plain_language_zh: 规则臂在门内给分级代价（余弦或负距离），门外给登记的哨兵 logit −1e6。S0-03 的代价矩阵要求每个被召回的对都有 logit，哨兵就是“不可选”的表达；每个色块都有自己的新建列且其 logit 有界，所以哨兵格永远不会进入最优分配，派生的禁止代价自动高于它。特征按 S0-03 封存的字段顺序取位置，不按写死的下标。

VSMT-lean.association_and_birth: learned heads a(f,e) and b(f) from METHOD section 7

training.loss: per-fragment softmax cross-entropy over [recalled columns..., BIRTH column] plus per-entity existence binary cross-entropy, equal weights

VSMT-lean.plain_language_zh: VSMT-lean 的配置只有 τ_r 一个维度，网络配方按 D-224 冻结：AdamW、学习率 1e-3、20 轮、按 validation loss 早停、5 个 seed、两轮 DAgger 且主表用第 1 轮；weight decay 与具体 seed 值待冻结（METHOD 提议 1e-4 与 7/19/31/43/59）。seed 不算配置。 v2：第 0 轮 DAgger 的记忆轨迹由 ELU-P 在预登记的 rollout_config 那一格上产生，S2-05 与 S3-03 用同一格，与 validation 选参无关（裁决 X4）。裁决 68（2026-09-25）冻结 weight decay 1e-4 与 seed 7/19/31/43/59（METHOD 提议值），τ_r 网格 0.3～0.9 步 0.1。

TAF.source: ConceptGraphs-style threshold association and fusion; unofficial adapter
TAF.association: logit = cosine if cosine >= theta_a and centroid distance <= d_a (d_a null means no distance gate), else the sentinel
TAF.birth: logit = theta_a, so the best cosine binds iff it reaches theta_a
TAF.existence: never retracts; every eligible candidate gets NOOP and misses accumulate under the shared dormancy rule
TAF.plain_language_zh: TAF 回答“像就并、不像就新建”够不够。门内 logit 是余弦本身而不是常数 0，否则两个合格实体之间会由求解器的字典序并列规则（按不透明 entity_id）决定绑谁。d_a 网格必须含 null（无距离门）。

ELU-P.source: Fusion++ existence log-odds with a Perpetua-style persistence decay; unofficial adapter
ELU-P.existence: per entity log-odds L: on each eligible unmatched frame L -= persistence_log_decay_per_tick + free_space_weight * free_space_coverage_ratio; RETRACT when L < retract_threshold; a match adds match_gain; a matched retracted entity is REACTIVATED by the shared compile step
ELU-P.plain_language_zh: ELU-P 回答“按概率慢慢忘”够不够。初始 log-odds、持续性衰减与匹配增益只在 train 上拟合，不进网格；网格只有门参数、自由空间权重和撤回门。 v2 登记了 rollout_config（第 0 轮 DAgger 与 HeuristicLabel 标签的固定一格，须是本网格成员且 d_a=None）和三个拟合量的估计程序（裁决 X4）。裁决 68（2026-09-25）冻结网格 theta_a {0.7}×d_a {None, 1.0}×free_space_weight {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}×retract_threshold {0.0, −1.0} 与 rollout_config (0.7, 1.0, 0.0)：校准趟 present 候选的自由空间覆盖基线约 0.65，权重与门括住 2～10 个合格未匹配帧后撤回。

quantities.initial_log_odds: logit of the train-split prior that an object still stands within delta_moved_m of its last-observed centroid at the first frame after an unobserved gap in which its place should be visible again; the ratio of such object-frames where it does over all such object-frames, from train private truth
quantities.persistence_log_decay_per_tick: -log(1 - h), where h is the per-tick hazard that a train-split object observable at least once is removed or moved: intervention events over the object-ticks those objects spend in the episode, from the train intervention logs
quantities.match_gain: log-likelihood ratio log(p_hit / p_false): p_hit is the fraction of should-be-visible frames of a present, in-place train object in which the ELU-P association gate at the registered rollout_config binds some fragment to that object's carrier entity; p_false is the same fraction over frames in which the object is absent or moved and its old place should be visible; both from the train split, the entity identity resolved by the S0-04 teacher after the train feature seals

fitting_procedure.plain_language_zh: 三个拟合量只在 train 上估一次、不进网格：初始 log-odds 是“看不见一阵子之后物体还在原处”的先验；持续性衰减由每帧被移走/搬动的风险率算出；匹配增益是“物体在时门内能配上”对“物体不在时门内仍配上”的对数似然比，门取登记的 rollout_config，因此所有 ELU-P 配置共用同一个增益。估计代码属 S2-02，数值待冻结。

RAC.association: same gate as TAF; a retracted entity is ineligible because the DSG adapter re-creates removed nodes
RAC.existence: free_space_coverage_ratio >= rho_rac counts one negative render, otherwise the count resets; n_rac consecutive negatives RETRACT
RAC.plain_language_zh: RAC 回答“把记忆画出来和现在比”够不够。渲染比对由共享前端完成：实体包围盒体素被可靠深度射线穿过的比例就是“观测深度比记忆表面更远”的像素比例，深度 margin 是前端共享值；RAC 与 ELU-P 的差别只在决策规则。它不复活 retracted 实体，被删节点重见只能新建，这是 DSG 适配的定义。

LOW.association: logit = -centroid distance if distance <= d_low, else the sentinel; the nearest entity wins
LOW.birth: logit = -d_low; with no gate, one below the farthest recalled distance of that fragment so any recalled entity beats birth
LOW.plain_language_zh: LOW 回答最简单的覆盖能到哪：最近的实体拿到色块、超过 d_low 就新建、从不撤回。它不读描述子。

NoVersion.modification: after every commit, retracted entities are physically deleted and the memory resealed; they no longer exist, so they cannot be recalled and a re-appearance can only BIRTH
NoVersion.plain_language_zh: NoVersion 回答可逆版本对被搬动物体的身份连续率值多少：撤回等于删除。

HandCost.association: logit = cosine for every recalled pair, no distance gate; a retracted entity may be reactivated
HandCost.existence: this frame's free_space_coverage_ratio >= rho_h retracts, else NOOP; no temporal state
HandCost.modification: the three learned heads are replaced by cosine, a constant and the current free-space coverage; solver, executor, vocabulary and reactivation are VSMT-lean's
HandCost.plain_language_zh: HandCost 回答“同一决策结构下学习代价值多少”（D-224-SW 裁决 S）：结构、求解器、词表与复活都是 VSMT-lean 的，只把三个学习头换成余弦、常数和当帧自由空间覆盖比例三个手写分数，没有时间累积。ELU-P 回答的是另一件事——时间累积的概率遗忘值多少——所以两者不再重合。

HeuristicLabel.modification: the same network is trained on the label-source arm's public decisions instead of private instance truth
HeuristicLabel.label_source_private_dependence: the labels are ELU-P's decisions on public inputs at the registered rollout_config; that arm's three fitted scalars (initial_log_odds, persistence_log_decay_per_tick, match_gain) are estimated on train private truth, and this is the only path by which private truth reaches HeuristicLabel's labels
HeuristicLabel.plain_language_zh: HeuristicLabel 回答私有实例真值相对公开启发式标签的贡献。标签来源是 ELU-P 在预登记 rollout_config 那一格上、对公开输入做出的决定（D-224-SW 裁决 T；D-224-X 裁决 X3/X4），同架构、同配方重训，不复用 VSMT-lean 权重。TAF 从不撤回，存在头会没有 gone 样本可学，所以不用它当标签源。复审修订（LOG-225）：ELU-P 的三个拟合量在 train 私有真值上估计，所以这些标签不是严格只用公开数据，私有信息只通过这三个标量进入；合同不再声称"只用公开数据"，而是写明这唯一的一条私有依赖。

AssocOnly.modification: the existence step is skipped entirely: no RETRACT, no NOOP, therefore no missed-opportunity count, no dormancy and no retracted set; every entity stays active
AssocOnly.plain_language_zh: AssocOnly 是贡献一的唯一因果反事实：同一个学习关联头、同一求解器、同一召回，词表只剩 BIND 与 BIRTH。它没有配置维度，必须与四个对照并列进主表。 “同一个学习关联头”指同架构同配方同预算重训，而不是复用 VSMT-lean 训好的权重：复用会让输入分布全变（状态 one-hot 恒为 active、错失次数恒为 0），反事实里混进分布偏移（裁决 X3）。
AssocOnly.association_head_training: the same architecture, optimizer, learning rate, epochs, early stopping, seeds, budget and two DAgger rounds as VSMT-lean, retrained on AssocOnly's own memory rollouts with the existence loss term removed; VSMT-lean's weights are never reused

appendix_arm.name: LLM-op
appendix_arm.input: the same sealed feature tables rendered as text; a frozen LLM chooses one atom per row
appendix_arm.plain_language_zh: LLM-op 必做，但只在 validation 上跑、只进附录、不进 test。它的成本与 prompt 敏感性使每方法 ≤12 配置的公平预算对它不成立，所以不进主表。

optional_arm.name: VSMT-lean-ctx
optional_arm.plain_language_zh: 上下文臂只在 S2-05 开发表上 VSMT-lean 的 amortization error 是三分解中最大一类时才启用；与 MLP 版共享训练预算与配置额度，结果单列，不得在看过 test 后替换主表行。

budget.selection_rule: one configuration per method by node F1 on validation (D-224-SW ruling V); ties to the smallest configuration index; main-gate metrics never select
budget.plain_language_zh: 每方法至多 12 个完整配置，网格在任何运行前预登记，参数只在 validation 上选，不抄论文在别的数据集上的数值。每个规则臂的距离门网格必须含 null（无门）。选配置的指标是 validation 上的节点 F1（裁决 V）：它是 Dyn-THOR 的主指标且不是主门指标，避免朝主门选参。裁决 68（2026-09-25）按 39 条校准分位数预登记全部网格：TAF 12、ELU-P 12、RAC 12、LOW 5、学习臂 τ_r 7、HandCost 12、AssocOnly 0；同物体余弦 ≥0.6/0.7/0.8 为 90.9/75.6/43.4%，异物体 49.2/32.4/15.6%，交叉区在 0.7 附近；距离门覆盖同物体 ≤0.5/1/2 m 的 35.5/46.3/65.3%；自由空间覆盖在当前几何规则下不区分在场与消失（present p50 0.667、gone 0.640），RAC／ELU-P 的网格只能括住基线。

user_rulings.S: HandCost is redefined as stateless hand scores in VSMT-lean's three head slots (cosine, theta_b, current free-space coverage against rho_h); it no longer coincides with ELU-P
user_rulings.T: HeuristicLabel takes ELU-P's public decisions as labels
user_rulings.U: RAC does not reactivate retracted entities, following the DSG adapter
user_rulings.V: one configuration per method is selected on validation by node F1; main-gate metrics never select
user_rulings.W: should_be_visible_min_ratio stays a shared null value registered in S0-05
user_rulings.plain_language_zh: 五项口径由用户于 2026-09-20 以 D-224-SW 批准，全部按 LOG-218 的推荐口径执行；本合同的臂定义、网格参数名与常量即其机器形式。
user_rulings.ruling_67: D-224-S1 裁决 67（2026-09-24 批准，原话「S2-05 审过；裁决 67 八个值全按推荐。」）：shared.should_be_visible_min_ratio=0.5，绑定常量 SHOULD_BE_VISIBLE_MIN_RATIO，登记进跨合同台账；其余八个 null 值（weight_decay、seeds、ELU-P 三个拟合量与 rollout_config 三值）归裁决 68 与拟合趟。
user_rulings.ruling_68: D-224-S1 裁决 68（2026-09-25 批准，原话「裁决 68 全按推荐」）：各臂网格（TAF theta_a {0.6,0.7,0.8}×d_a {None,0.5,1,2}；ELU-P theta_a {0.7}×d_a {None,1}×free_space_weight {{0.5,1,2}}×retract_threshold {{0,−1}}；RAC theta_a {{0.7}}×d_a {{None,1}}×rho_rac {{0.7,0.85}}×n_rac {{2,3,5}}；LOW d_low {{None,0.25,0.5,1,2}}；VSMT-lean／NoVersion／HeuristicLabel／VSMT-lean-ctx tau_r 0.3～0.9 步 0.1；HandCost theta_b {{0.6,0.7,0.8}}×rho_h {{0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9}}；AssocOnly 空）绑定 FROZEN_GRIDS；rollout_config (0.7, 1.0, 0.0) 绑定 ROLLOUT_CONFIG；weight_decay 1e-4、seeds [7,19,31,43,59] 绑定 WEIGHT_DECAY／SEEDS；shared.should_be_visible_min_ratio 0.5→1/64（裁决 67 值进 SUPERSEDED_VALUES）绑定 SHOULD_BE_VISIBLE_MIN_RATIO；三个拟合量仍为 null，由 elu_p_fit 趟产出后直接登记（裁决 68 (10) 预授权）。网格与取代记录进入规则摘要，S0-05 重钉。

continue_gate.plain_language_zh: S0-05 的继续门是：每方法网格 ≤12 且预登记；规则臂无梯度；合同里的每一个布尔声称都被校验器绑定。检查通过不等于任何臂有效，也不等于数值合适。

supersedes_contract.note_zh: v1 已于 2026-09-20 经用户审查通过（LOG-219），字节冻结不改；v2 按 D-224-X 落实裁决 X3（AssocOnly 与 HeuristicLabel 为同配方重训而非复用权重）与 X4（预登记 ELU-P 轨迹配置供第 0 轮 DAgger 与 HeuristicLabel 标签，登记三个拟合量的估计程序）。五项 D-224-SW 口径与全部网格逐字不变。

user_rulings_v2.X3: AssocOnly (and HeuristicLabel) retrain the same architecture with the same recipe, budget and DAgger rounds on their own rollouts; AssocOnly drops the existence loss term; no weight reuse
user_rulings_v2.X4: one pre-registered no-gate ELU-P grid member is the rollout configuration for DAgger round 0 and HeuristicLabel labels in S2-05 and S3-03; the three fitted quantities have a registered estimation procedure on the train split
user_rulings_v2.plain_language_zh: 两项口径由用户于 2026-09-20 以 D-224-X 批准。
user_rulings_v2.review_corrections: 2026-09-20 second review (LOG-225): HeuristicLabel's public-data claim replaced by the exact statement of its single private dependence through ELU-P's three fitted scalars; arms_without_atom registered for the S0-04 not-applicable rule
